content.short: Koi Finance is a fast DEX with yield farming and bond features, built on zkSync.
content.description: Koi Finance tackles high DeFi transaction fees and slow processing times by leveraging zkSync’s Layer 2 scaling solution. The platform delivers faster, cheaper swaps, trades, and liquidity options, reducing friction for everyday users and enabling yield farming. It also supports governance through veKOI tokens, letting holders participate in decisions while benefiting from enhanced security features. All of this is presented in a straightforward, user-friendly interface that simplifies interactions across multiple chains.
